title: Translation and Literary Design of Matthew 8:1-4
caption: <bp-cite>Matthew 8:1-4</bp-cite>. Translation and Literary Design by The Good News kata Matthew (work in progress).
usx:
<usx version="2.6" status="translated">
  <para>
    <group type="secondary">
      <group>
        <verse number="1" /> Now when he <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="tan">came down from the mountain</char>,
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="cyan">many crowds</char> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="purple">followed</char> him.
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group>
        <verse number="2" /> And look, a <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="red" word-lang="greek" word-original="λεπρὸς">skin-diseased</char> <char style="add">man</char>,
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group>
        <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="turquoise" word-lang="greek" word-original="προσελθὼν">approaching</char>,
      </group>
      <group>
        <char mark-variant="highlight-dark" mark-color="green">was bowing down to him</char>, saying,
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        “<char style="bd" mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="black">Master</char><note style="x" caller="+" xref="matthew-8-2-master"><char style="xt">Matthew 7:21</char></note>, if you <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="blue" word-lang="greek" word-original="θέλῃς">want</char>,
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        you are able <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="green" word-lang="greek" word-original="καθαρίσαι" word-gloss="clean / pure">to make me clean</char>.”
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group>
        <verse number="3" /> And <char style="bd">stretching out the hand</char><note style="x" caller="+" xref="matthew-8-3-hand"><char style="xt">Exodus 3:20</char></note>,
      </group>
      <group>
        he <char mark-variant="highlight-dark" mark-color="green">touched him</char>, saying,
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        “I <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="blue" word-lang="greek" word-original="Θέλω">want</char>.
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="green" word-lang="greek" word-original="καθαρίσθητι" word-gloss="clean / pure">Be clean</char>.”
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group>
        And immediately his <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="red" word-lang="greek" word-original="λέπρα">skin disease</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="green" word-lang="greek" word-original="ἐκαθαρίσθη" word-gloss="clean / pure">was made clean</char>.
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group type="secondary">
      <group>
        <verse number="4" /> And Iesous said to him,
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        “See <char style="add">that</char> you <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">tell no one</char>,
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        but <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="purple">go</char>,
      </group>
      <group indent="2">
        show yourself to the priest,
      </group>
      <group indent="2">
        and present the offering that Mouses commanded,
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        as a <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">witness</char> to <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="cyan">them</char>.”
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
</usx>
